metadata.description: Battle-tested plugins for Rails developers building mobile apps with Hotwire Native and deploying with Kamal

plugins.name: hotwire-native
plugins.description: Battle-tested skill for building iOS/Android apps with Hotwire Native: path configuration, native screens, bridge components, push notifications, and deployment. Covers real-world gotchas the official docs don't tell you.

plugins.name: kamal
plugins.description: Skill for deploying Rails apps with Kamal: zero-downtime deployments, accessory setup, environment configuration, and rollbacks.
